structured_output.summary: Source-only freeze of the Gameness outcome_frame_v1 standard for G035 "异星裂谷的分支勘探" (branching roguelite card expedition). All 39 CHECKS keep their original ids and their original layout / guidance / feedback group meanings; layout and guidance checks stay about visible UI structure, controls and player comprehension and are not converted into mechanic win/defeat probes, while the feedback checks are each defined as exactly one visible event outcome or one perceptible interaction response. Because no delivery or baseline is provided, every field is written implementation-neutral: it names which on-screen object must be visible, what visibly happens to it, and what a single genuine native frame must show, so the same criterion applies unchanged to any model. All numeric, timing, spatial, animation-curve and branch/edge specifics that appear in the original requirement (scale factors, durations, shake amplitudes, damage/ore/HP values, cooldowns, exhaustive option and boundary sets) are carried only as original_requirement_diagnostic_only for traceability and are never gates at the 50 or 100 tier. The three levels remain non-additive: 10% real implementation wired to gameplay, 50% the interaction is actually triggered and basic feedback/UI/guidance works with the correct object and correct core information and no known basic bug while the intended result is not yet sufficiently established, 100% a delivered real native result frame plus the minimum necessary context shows the intended communication works and is broadly correct and recognizable so the player understands the result or the next action. Decorative motion or a success caption never substitutes for the actual effect; wrong object, reversed victory/defeat, unreadable key text or unusable controls are basic bugs; uncovered evidence stays unknown rather than a bug; a correct refusal requires the operation to be handled and refused rather than an unchanged screen.

game.layout.hierarchy.visible_goal: On a genuine gameplay screen the UI has a clear visual hierarchy: the state the player must read at a glance (current HP, the resource gating the current action, whose phase it is) visibly dominates, and supporting details read as subordinate.
game.layout.hierarchy.result_frame_description: One real battle-HUD or route-map frame in which the primary readouts are markedly larger or more prominent and clearly separated from smaller supporting labels, so a viewer can immediately point to the main state.
game.layout.hierarchy.correct_target_and_information: The dominant layer must carry the screen's real primary state (player HP and the current phase or available action); the subordinate layer must carry genuinely secondary state (deck count, seed, node labels, markers). Hierarchy must describe real information, not decorate an arbitrary element.
game.layout.hierarchy.necessary_context: One genuine gameplay screen is enough; a second screen (route map beside battle HUD) only if the primary/subordinate split is genuinely ambiguous in the first.
game.layout.hierarchy.representative_basic_function: Entering a battle and reading HP, energy and deck count off the HUD.
basic_function_bugs: Primary and secondary information are rendered at the same size, weight and placement, so nothing reads as the main state.
A key state such as HP or the current phase/resource is missing, leaving no hierarchy to judge.
Panels overlap or stack so the intended primary readout is pushed behind secondary chrome.
game.layout.hierarchy.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 实际UI信息层级清楚，主要状态与次要信息可区分。

game.layout.readable.visible_goal: UI text, numbers and icons on the genuine screens are legible: readable size, sufficient contrast against the background, and no overlapping or clipped elements for the figures the player acts on.
game.layout.readable.result_frame_description: One real HUD or panel frame in which every visible label and number can be read without ambiguity and none is covered by another element or cut off at a panel edge.
game.layout.readable.correct_target_and_information: Legibility must hold for the informational items that matter: HP, energy/cost, deck count, node and event labels and button captions must be readable and unoccluded.
game.layout.readable.necessary_context: One genuine screen; a second frame only if overlap or clipping appears at a specific interaction state the first frame does not show.
game.layout.readable.representative_basic_function: Reading HP, energy and card costs on the battle HUD, and reading node labels on the route map.
basic_function_bugs: Text overlaps other text or UI so key numbers cannot be read.
Contrast is so low that labels disappear into the background.
Labels or numbers are clipped by panel bounds or hidden behind an overlay.
game.layout.readable.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 实际UI文字、尺寸、对比度及布局可读，无明显遮挡/重叠。

game.guidance.controls.visible_goal: The running game visibly communicates the operations needed to play: an on-screen hint or legend names the real actions available on that screen (select a route node, play a card, end the turn, open pause, use the save stone).
game.guidance.controls.result_frame_description: One real gameplay frame carrying an on-screen control hint whose wording or keys match the operations that screen actually supports.
game.guidance.controls.correct_target_and_information: The hint must name operations that exist and their real inputs; it must not advertise a key or action the screen does not accept.
game.guidance.controls.necessary_context: The screen where the hint appears; one further screen (battle versus route map) only if the hint is context-specific.
game.guidance.controls.representative_basic_function: Reading the hint and performing the stated action, such as clicking a card or ending the turn.

The hint names keys or actions the screen does not actually accept.

expanded.G.s0016.visible_goal: A failed ore gamble collapses the crack and shows a floating HP-loss figure while the player's HP drops.
expanded.G.s0016.result_frame_description: A real event frame with the crack collapsing and a floating negative HP value over the player, with the HP readout visibly reduced.
expanded.G.s0016.correct_target_and_information: The collapse must be at the gambled crack, and the HP figure must read as a loss applied to the player, matching the reduced HP counter.
expanded.G.s0016.necessary_context: The collapse frame plus the frame where the HP counter has settled at its new value.
expanded.G.s0016.representative_basic_function: Choosing the gamble option and receiving the losing outcome.
basic_function_bugs: Success imagery such as crystal burst and ore gain plays on a failure.
No collapse effect appears.
HP is not reduced, or the loss is shown against the wrong object.
expanded.G.s0016.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【赌矿失败】实际发生时可视表现为【裂缝坍塌＋−20 HP 飘字】，结束条件【1.2 秒结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0017.visible_goal: Completing a merchant trade visibly adds the acquired rare card into the player's deck, so the new card can be seen joining the collection.
expanded.G.s0017.result_frame_description: A real frame in which the newly acquired rare card is shown entering the deck: the card moving into the deck or hand area, the deck count increasing, or the card displayed in the deck list.
expanded.G.s0017.correct_target_and_information: The card that joins the deck must be the rare card actually acquired in the trade, and it must land in the player's deck rather than a reward slot or unrelated display.
expanded.G.s0017.necessary_context: The trade confirmation plus the frame where the card is in the deck.
expanded.G.s0017.representative_basic_function: Paying the merchant and receiving the rare card.
basic_function_bugs: No card is added anywhere after a successful trade.
A card other than the acquired rare card appears as the new addition.
The trade completes with no visible acquisition moment and the deck is unchanged on screen.
expanded.G.s0017.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【交换成交】实际发生时可视表现为【稀有卡入组】，结束条件【入组完成】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0018.visible_goal: Taking a contaminated supply attaches purple mist to a dedicated HUD marker, and from then on the enemies carry a purple glow.
expanded.G.s0018.result_frame_description: A real combat frame showing the contamination marker on the HUD with purple mist on it and the enemy units tinted or auraed purple.
expanded.G.s0018.correct_target_and_information: The marker must be the HUD contamination marker and the purple glow must be on the enemy units whose attacks are boosted; the state must persist beyond the node where it was taken.
expanded.G.s0018.necessary_context: The frame where contamination attaches to the HUD plus a later combat frame showing glowing enemies, since the second is the persistent consequence.
expanded.G.s0018.representative_basic_function: Taking the damaged supply cache, then entering the next battle.
basic_function_bugs: No contamination marker appears on the HUD.
The purple effect lands on the UI or on the player instead of the enemies.
The marker and glow vanish after moving to the next node instead of persisting.
expanded.G.s0018.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【补给污染生效】实际发生时可视表现为【紫雾附在 HUD 标记上（此后敌人带紫光）】，结束条件【挂载完成】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0019.visible_goal: Interacting with the save stone runs a rotating rune ring and a success halo that confirms the save completed.
expanded.G.s0019.result_frame_description: A real frame at the save stone with the rune ring rotating and a success light ring or halo around it.
expanded.G.s0019.correct_target_and_information: The effect must be at the save stone that was used, and the halo must read as a completed save rather than a neutral idle glow.
expanded.G.s0019.necessary_context: The interaction frame plus the halo frame; one frame suffices when both are visible together.
expanded.G.s0019.representative_basic_function: Pressing the interact key at the save stone.
basic_function_bugs: No rune rotation or halo appears on interaction.
The success halo plays although nothing is saved.
The effect appears on an object other than the save stone.
expanded.G.s0019.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【存档】实际发生时可视表现为【符文环旋转＋保存成功光圈】，结束条件【光圈结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0020.visible_goal: Loading a save produces a reverse-playback-style flash across the scene before the restored state appears.
expanded.G.s0020.result_frame_description: A real frame of the load flash or afterimage over the scene, immediately followed by the restored game state.
expanded.G.s0020.correct_target_and_information: The flash must accompany the load operation and be followed by the restored saved state, not by an unchanged or unrelated scene.
expanded.G.s0020.necessary_context: The flash frame plus the frame after it showing the restored state.
expanded.G.s0020.representative_basic_function: Loading the save and returning to the saved point.
basic_function_bugs: No flash appears on load.
The flash belongs to the save action rather than load.
The screen is unchanged after the operation, with no restore and no refusal.
expanded.G.s0020.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【读档】实际发生时可视表现为【倒放式闪光】，结束条件【闪光结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0021.visible_goal: Playing a card moves it out of the hand and settles it into the play position while the card's target lights up.
expanded.G.s0021.result_frame_description: A real combat frame with the played card settled in the play area and the affected target highlighted.
expanded.G.s0021.correct_target_and_information: The settled card must be the card that was played, and the highlight must sit on the target that card actually affects.
expanded.G.s0021.necessary_context: The frame during resolution; the pre-play hand frame only if it is unclear which card left the hand.
expanded.G.s0021.representative_basic_function: Playing an attack card at an enemy.
basic_function_bugs: The card stays in hand and nothing settles in the play area.
No target is highlighted.
The highlight sits on a different object than the one the card affects.
expanded.G.s0021.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【出牌】实际发生时可视表现为【卡牌落位＋目标高亮】，结束条件【结算完成】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0022.visible_goal: An attack landing on an enemy produces a slash or shockwave at that enemy plus a floating damage figure, and the heavier strike also shakes the screen.
expanded.G.s0022.result_frame_description: A real combat frame with the slash or shockwave on the struck enemy and the damage value floating over it; for the heavy strike the frame is visibly displaced by screen shake.
expanded.G.s0022.correct_target_and_information: The impact and the damage float must be on the enemy that was hit, and the number must correspond to the attack that landed.
expanded.G.s0022.necessary_context: The impact frame; one further frame for the shake if a still cannot show the displacement.
expanded.G.s0022.representative_basic_function: Playing a strike card on an enemy and watching it land.
basic_function_bugs: The attack resolves with no impact effect and no damage float.
Impact and damage appear on the wrong unit.
The effect plays but the enemy's HP or block does not change.
expanded.G.s0022.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【攻击命中（打击/强击）】实际发生时可视表现为【刀光/冲击波＋伤害飘字（强击并震屏）】，结束条件【0.3 秒结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0023.visible_goal: Using the energize card wraps the player character in a red aura as the buff is applied.
expanded.G.s0023.result_frame_description: A real combat frame with a red aura around the player character.
expanded.G.s0023.correct_target_and_information: The aura must be on the player who gained the power buff, not on an enemy or empty space, and it must be recognisable as distinct from damage and block effects.
expanded.G.s0023.necessary_context: The cast frame; a later frame only if the aura's persistence is in question.
basic_function_bugs: No red aura appears when energize is played.
The aura appears on the enemy or elsewhere instead of the player.
The aura is indistinguishable from unrelated effects, so the buff cannot be read.
expanded.G.s0023.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【蓄能】实际发生时可视表现为【红色气场】，结束条件【0.5 秒结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0024.visible_goal: Gaining block surrounds the unit with a shield bubble while the block value is shown.
expanded.G.s0024.result_frame_description: A real combat frame with a shield bubble around the player and the block value visible on the HUD or unit.
expanded.G.s0024.correct_target_and_information: The bubble must be on the unit that gained block, and the displayed block value must agree with that gain.
expanded.G.s0024.necessary_context: The block-gain frame; a second frame only if the bubble is transient and overlaps another effect.
basic_function_bugs: No shield bubble appears.
The bubble appears on the wrong unit.
The bubble plays but the block value never changes.
expanded.G.s0024.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【获得格挡】实际发生时可视表现为【护盾泡】，结束条件【0.3 秒结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0025.visible_goal: At the poison resolution step, green bubbles rise from the poisoned enemy and a tick damage figure pops over it.
expanded.G.s0025.result_frame_description: A real combat frame with green bubbles over the poisoned enemy and the tick damage value floating there.
expanded.G.s0025.correct_target_and_information: The green bubbles and tick figure must be on the poisoned unit and must read as poison damage, distinct from a normal attack hit.
expanded.G.s0025.necessary_context: The tick frame; a second frame if the stack or HP change must be tied to it.
expanded.G.s0025.representative_basic_function: Ending the turn so the poisoned enemy takes poison damage.
basic_function_bugs: No green bubble or tick damage appears at poison resolution.
The tick is shown on a unit that is not poisoned.
Poison damage is rendered as a normal attack hit, so the two cannot be told apart.
expanded.G.s0025.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【中毒结算】实际发生时可视表现为【绿色气泡跳伤】，结束条件【跳伤结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0026.visible_goal: The boss's attack produces a shockwave with a screen shake and a brief hitstop as it lands on the player.
expanded.G.s0026.result_frame_description: A real combat frame showing the shockwave from the boss with the view visibly displaced by shake, and the player taking the hit.
expanded.G.s0026.correct_target_and_information: The shockwave must originate from the boss and the impact and damage must land on the player; the shake must accompany this landing rather than a different event.
expanded.G.s0026.necessary_context: The impact frame plus one adjacent frame to evidence the shake and hitstop, since both are transient.
expanded.G.s0026.representative_basic_function: Letting the boss take its attack turn.
basic_function_bugs: The boss attack resolves with no shockwave.
The effect lands on the boss itself or on nothing, with no player hit.
The screen shakes on an unrelated action while the boss attack shows no shake.
expanded.G.s0026.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【首领攻击】实际发生时可视表现为【冲击波＋0.2 秒震屏＋0.08 秒顿帧】，结束条件【0.3 秒结束】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0027.visible_goal: Finishing a run triggers a full-screen victory or defeat effect carrying the matching ending imagery, after which the result panel appears.
expanded.G.s0027.result_frame_description: A real frame of the full-screen victory or defeat effect and the result panel it hands off to, with the ending imagery matching the outcome that actually occurred.
expanded.G.s0027.correct_target_and_information: The effect must be the victory variant when the boss was defeated and the defeat variant when the player died, and the panel that follows must state the corresponding outcome.
expanded.G.s0027.necessary_context: The full-screen effect frame plus the result panel frame, since the effect hands off to the panel.
expanded.G.s0027.representative_basic_function: Defeating the boss, or losing all HP, and watching the run end.
basic_function_bugs: The defeat effect plays on a victory, or the victory effect on a defeat.
No full-screen end effect appears at all.
The effect plays but no result panel follows, leaving the run without an end screen.
expanded.G.s0027.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 事件【胜负结算】实际发生时可视表现为【全屏特效（双结局意象见 W04）】，结束条件【进入结算面板】。仅评价可视投影，音频未评。未触发事件不能PASS。

expanded.G.s0037.visible_goal: The front-end screen chain exists and is reachable — title with start/settings/quit and seed display and input, route map with current layer and open state and chosen path and node labels, event panel with numbered options, battle HUD, pause panel, reward panel, result panel — each showing its own characteristic content.
expanded.G.s0037.result_frame_description: Real frames of the screens in the chain in which each screen is identifiable by its own content: seed field on the title, layers and node labels on the route map, numbered choices on the event panel, HP and energy and deck on the battle HUD, continue/restart/menu on the pause panel, a card choice on the reward panel, and the run summary on the result panel.
expanded.G.s0037.correct_target_and_information: Each screen must show the content that identifies it and belongs to that phase; navigation must lead from one screen to the next in the intended order, and the result panel must state the victory or defeat outcome.
expanded.G.s0037.necessary_context: One frame per screen class; because transitions matter, adjacent frames may be needed to show the next screen was reached from the previous one.
expanded.G.s0037.representative_basic_function: Starting a run and stepping through title, route map, event, battle, pause, reward and result.
basic_function_bugs: A required front-end screen is missing or unreachable.
A screen shows another screen's content or is mislabelled, such as the reward panel showing the result summary.
An overlay blocks the screen so its content cannot be identified.
expanded.G.s0037.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: - F10 前端界面：标题（开始/设置/退出，含 seed 显示与输入）→ 路线图界面（当前层/开放状态/已选路径/节点标签）→ 事件面板（选项 1–4）→ 战斗 HUD（HP/费用/牌堆计数/意图栏/污染标记，见 I06）→ 暂停面板（继续/重开/返回/设置）→ 奖励面板 → 结算面板（胜利显示路线选择/构筑终态/剩余 HP 与矿

expanded.G.s0038.visible_goal: The defeat result screen names the route node at which the player fell.
expanded.G.s0038.result_frame_description: A real defeat-panel frame containing a node name or identifier alongside the failure statement.
expanded.G.s0038.correct_target_and_information: The named node must be the node where the run actually ended, and the panel must read as a defeat rather than a victory.
expanded.G.s0038.necessary_context: The defeat panel frame plus, if needed, the frame of the node where the player died, to check the name matches.
expanded.G.s0038.representative_basic_function: Losing all HP in a battle and reading the defeat panel.
basic_function_bugs: The defeat panel appears with no node information.
The panel names a node different from the one where the player died.
The panel is a victory-style summary instead of a defeat record.
expanded.G.s0038.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 失败注明倒在哪一节点

expanded.G.s0039.visible_goal: On the result screen, pressing Enter starts a fresh run with the same seed and leaves the result screen, returning the player to play.
expanded.G.s0039.result_frame_description: A real frame after the restart input showing a new run at its beginning (title or first-layer route map with reset state) instead of the stale result panel, with the restart prompt visible on the result screen.
expanded.G.s0039.correct_target_and_information: The restart must reset the run state (HP, ore and deck back to their starting values) and reuse the seed of the ended run; the result screen must show that Enter restarts.
expanded.G.s0039.necessary_context: The result screen with its prompt plus the frame after Enter, since the action and its effect are two moments.
expanded.G.s0039.representative_basic_function: Pressing Enter on the result panel.
basic_function_bugs: Enter does nothing on the result screen.
Enter leaves the result panel but the run state is stale or unchanged.
No restart prompt is shown, so the entry cannot be discovered.

expanded.G.s0040.visible_goal: Key states are shown with an icon together with a text label, rather than by colour or icon alone.
expanded.G.s0040.result_frame_description: A real HUD frame in which the key states (HP, ore, deck count, contamination marker, enemy intent) each carry an icon and a readable text label.
expanded.G.s0040.correct_target_and_information: The icon and label pair must correspond to the state it represents and remain readable; colour must not be the only carrier of the meaning.
expanded.G.s0040.necessary_context: One HUD frame showing the key states; a second frame only if a state appears solely in another phase.
expanded.G.s0040.representative_basic_function: Reading the HUD during battle and on the route map.
basic_function_bugs: Key states are conveyed by colour alone with no icon or text.
Icons appear without any text label, so their meaning must be guessed.
An icon and label pair is attached to a different state than the one it describes.
expanded.G.s0040.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 关键状态图标＋文字并用

expanded.G.s0041.visible_goal: When the game window loses focus, play pauses and the pause panel comes up, freezing the simulation.
expanded.G.s0041.result_frame_description: A real frame taken after the window loses focus showing the pause panel over a scene whose battle state is unchanged from the moment of blur.
expanded.G.s0041.correct_target_and_information: The panel must be the pause panel with continue, restart and menu entries, and the underlying state must match the pre-blur state, showing the game did not advance.
expanded.G.s0041.necessary_context: The frame at blur and the frame after time has passed, since the freeze is shown by the state not changing.
expanded.G.s0041.representative_basic_function: Clicking away from the window during a battle.
basic_function_bugs: No pause occurs on focus loss.
The pause panel opens but the battle visibly keeps advancing underneath.
A different panel appears instead of pause, leaving play unblocked.

expanded.G.s0001.visible_goal: The route map and HUD persistently display the current layer, the ore total, player HP, the deck count and the enemy buff marker.
expanded.G.s0001.result_frame_description: A real route-map frame carrying all required readouts, including the second-layer open or locked state and the contamination or buff marker, each with a label.
expanded.G.s0001.correct_target_and_information: Each readout must show the state actually held at that moment (layer and its open state, ore, HP, deck size, enemy buff), and they must stay present as the player moves between nodes.
expanded.G.s0001.necessary_context: A route-map frame plus a battle frame, since the same readouts must persist into combat.
expanded.G.s0001.representative_basic_function: Looking at the HUD on the route map and in battle.
basic_function_bugs: One of the required readouts (layer, ore, HP, deck count, buff marker) is absent.
A readout shows a value that does not match the actual state.
The readouts disappear when moving to the next node instead of persisting.
expanded.G.s0001.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: - I06 UI 必须显示的状态：路线图当前层（含第 2 层开放状态）、矿、HP、牌组计数、敌方增益标记须常驻显示

expanded.G.s0003.visible_goal: The UI objects and interactables the design relies on — menu, HUD, event panel, save stone, result panel and route nodes — exist in the running build and can actually be entered or operated.
expanded.G.s0003.result_frame_description: A real frame showing one such object in an operable state, such as the save stone being used, a route node responding to a click, or the event panel open, demonstrating it is not a static prop.
expanded.G.s0003.correct_target_and_information: The object must be the one the design names, and the frame must show a response to interaction (panel open, node highlighted, save effect) rather than an idle prop.
expanded.G.s0003.necessary_context: The object before and after interaction, since existence is shown by its response.
expanded.G.s0003.representative_basic_function: Clicking a route node, opening an event panel, or using the save stone.
basic_function_bugs: A required object is absent from the running build.
The object is present but does not respond to interaction.
Only a static image or placeholder stands in for the object, with no operable behaviour.
expanded.G.s0003.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: - L03 目标物/交互物/场景/UI 对象：本 spec §3–§7 引用的界面元素（菜单/HUD/结算面板）与交互物逐类存在且运行时可进入

expanded.G.s0004.visible_goal: The entities shown in play correspond to the specified roster and carry the specified visible attributes: each card is one of the named card types with its cost and effect text, and each enemy is one of the named enemy types with its HP and attack displayed.
expanded.G.s0004.result_frame_description: A real battle frame showing cards and an enemy with names, costs and stat values that correspond to the specified entries.
expanded.G.s0004.correct_target_and_information: The names, costs and stats on screen must match the entry they represent: a card must not be renamed or re-costed, and an enemy must display the stats of the type it is.
expanded.G.s0004.necessary_context: A battle frame covering the cards in hand and the enemy in play; a second frame only if other types appear later.
expanded.G.s0004.representative_basic_function: Inspecting a card in hand and the enemy's displayed stats.
basic_function_bugs: An entity of an unspecified type appears where a specified type should be.
A displayed attribute contradicts the entity's entry, such as a wrong cost or wrong HP and attack label.
The same generic entity is reused to stand for different specified types.
expanded.G.s0004.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 数量与属性以对应 G·M 条目为准。

expanded.G.s0002.visible_goal: All the generated content classes appear in play: the route map with its node icons, the card set, the enemy types, the explorer character, the event panel, the save stone and the HUD.
expanded.G.s0002.result_frame_description: Real frames covering the route map with distinguishable node icons, a hand of cards, an enemy on the battle stage, the explorer character, an open event panel, the save stone and the HUD.
expanded.G.s0002.correct_target_and_information: Each class must be present and identifiable as its own thing: a node icon must read as a node, the event panel as the event panel and the HUD as the HUD, rather than one generic panel covering several roles.
expanded.G.s0002.necessary_context: One frame per content class across the route map and the battle, since no single screen shows all of them.
expanded.G.s0002.representative_basic_function: Moving through a run so every content class is encountered.
basic_function_bugs: One of the listed classes (route nodes, cards, enemies, explorer, event panel, save stone, HUD) is missing.
A class is replaced by an unrelated generic object so it cannot be identified.
The HUD or event panel is only static decoration with no content.
expanded.G.s0002.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: - L01 生成对象：路线图与节点图标、**卡牌 6 种（打击/防御/强击/护壁/蓄能/灼烧弹）**、敌人 3 型（外缘/精英/首领，原创造型）、勘探员角色、事件面板、存档石、HUD（矿/HP/牌组/标记）。

expanded.G.s0046.visible_goal: The interface lets the player judge current resources and whether an action is possible, and when an action cannot be performed it states the reason.
expanded.G.s0046.result_frame_description: A real frame of a refused action in which the blocking cause is written out (insufficient energy or ore, deck full) alongside the resource readouts that explain it.
expanded.G.s0046.correct_target_and_information: The stated reason must be the actual blocking condition, and the resource display must agree with it (energy below the card's cost, ore below the gamble or trade price, deck at its limit).
expanded.G.s0046.necessary_context: The refusal frame with the resources visible; a second frame only if the resource state must be compared before and after.
expanded.G.s0046.representative_basic_function: Trying an action that the current resources do not allow.
basic_function_bugs: The action is refused with no reason given.
The reason names a condition other than the one actually blocking.
The action is allowed although the displayed resources do not permit it.
expanded.G.s0046.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 界面支持玩家判断当前资源和行动条件，并明确传达无法执行的原因。

expanded.G.s0042.visible_goal: The interface shows the current objective and the next available action, so the player knows what to do without external documentation.
expanded.G.s0042.result_frame_description: A real gameplay frame carrying an objective or next-step line, such as a route-map prompt naming the current layer goal or a battle prompt naming the available action.
expanded.G.s0042.correct_target_and_information: The stated objective must match the phase the player is in, and the suggested next action must be one the screen actually accepts.
expanded.G.s0042.necessary_context: One frame at the phase in question; a second frame only if the objective changes between route and battle.
expanded.G.s0042.representative_basic_function: Entering the route map and reading what to do next.
basic_function_bugs: No objective or next step is shown anywhere.
The objective contradicts the current phase, such as battle text on the route map.
The suggested action cannot actually be performed on that screen.
expanded.G.s0042.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 玩家能在操作前知道当前目标及可执行的下一步，不依赖阅读工程文档。

expanded.G.s0044.visible_goal: The player is shown where they are in the run (layer and route progress), when the stage changes, and what the final outcome is.
expanded.G.s0044.result_frame_description: A real frame carrying layer and route progress (current layer and the path reached) and, at the end, the result panel stating victory or defeat.
expanded.G.s0044.correct_target_and_information: The progress display must agree with the layer actually reached, and the result panel must state the outcome that actually occurred.
expanded.G.s0044.necessary_context: A route-progress frame plus the result frame; a stage-change frame if the change itself is in question.
expanded.G.s0044.representative_basic_function: Advancing to the next layer and reading the progress, then reaching the result panel.
basic_function_bugs: No run progress is indicated at all.
The displayed layer or path does not match where the player actually is.
The run ends with no result statement.
expanded.G.s0044.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 目标进度、阶段变化与终局结果向玩家明确呈现。

expanded.G.s0049.visible_goal: A state that persists across nodes or is lost, such as the contamination debuff or carried HP and ore, is given a visible explanation the player can read.
expanded.G.s0049.result_frame_description: A real frame in which the persistent state carries an explanatory label or tooltip stating its effect, for example the contamination marker paired with text about stronger enemies.
expanded.G.s0049.correct_target_and_information: The explanation must describe the state the player actually holds, and must not describe a consequence that is not in effect.
expanded.G.s0049.necessary_context: The frame showing the persistent state and its explanation; a later frame only if persistence itself is in question.
expanded.G.s0049.representative_basic_function: Reading the contamination marker after taking the tainted supply.
basic_function_bugs: A persistent state is shown with no explanation of what it does.
The explanation describes a consequence the player does not actually have.
The state is explained only in an external document and never on screen.
expanded.G.s0049.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 长期后果、跨阶段保留或失去的状态有可观察的解释；仅在需求存在时判断。

expanded.G.s0045.visible_goal: Route branches and event choices show their cost and payoff before the player commits, so the trade-off is understandable.
expanded.G.s0045.result_frame_description: A real route-map frame in which each node carries a risk and reward label (what it costs and what it yields), and an event panel listing the cost and benefit of each option.
expanded.G.s0045.correct_target_and_information: The labels must match the branch or option they sit on, with a gamble node labelled as a gamble and a costly trade labelled with its price, not swapped or generic.
expanded.G.s0045.necessary_context: The route map before selection and the event panel before choosing, since both are decision points.
expanded.G.s0045.representative_basic_function: Reading a route node or event option before choosing it.
basic_function_bugs: No risk or reward information is shown before choosing.
Labels are attached to the wrong node or option.
The label contradicts the actual branch, such as a combat node described as a free reward.
expanded.G.s0045.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 冻结玩法中的资源/路线/时机选择有可理解的代价与收益提示。

expanded.G.s0047.visible_goal: Danger warnings (the boss's coming attack, low HP, poison) and recovery entries (save stone, pause, restart) are visible and discoverable so the player can adjust.
expanded.G.s0047.result_frame_description: A real frame showing a danger warning tied to the actual threat alongside a discoverable recovery entry, such as the boss intent displayed with the save stone or pause access visible.
expanded.G.s0047.correct_target_and_information: The warning must describe the threat actually pending, and the recovery entry shown must be one that is available at that point.
expanded.G.s0047.necessary_context: The warning frame; the frame of the recovery entry if it lives on another screen.
expanded.G.s0047.representative_basic_function: Reading the boss's intent before it attacks, and locating the save stone or pause.
basic_function_bugs: No warning is shown for a pending dangerous action.
The warning does not match the actual threat.
No recovery entry such as save stone, pause or restart can be found when it is needed.
expanded.G.s0047.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 危险预警与恢复入口可发现，玩家能据此调整操作。

expanded.G.s0043.visible_goal: The feedback for a core action's success, failure and refusal are visually distinguishable from one another.
expanded.G.s0043.result_frame_description: Frames of the same core action in accepted, rejected and failed outcomes, each with a distinct visible treatment, such as the card settling and the target reacting, versus the card shaking in hand, versus a loss effect on the player.
expanded.G.s0043.correct_target_and_information: Each outcome's treatment must belong to that outcome class, so a refusal cannot be mistaken for a successful play and a failure cannot be shown as a success.
expanded.G.s0043.necessary_context: The outcome frames for the action; at minimum the accepted and refused frames, plus the failed frame where that outcome exists.
expanded.G.s0043.representative_basic_function: Playing a legal card, attempting an illegal one, and suffering a failed action.
basic_function_bugs: A refused action looks identical to a successful one.
A failed action is presented as a success.
No feedback distinguishes the outcomes at all.
expanded.G.s0043.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 核心操作产生的成功、失败或拒绝反馈可被区分；此处不重复计算 C2 数值正确性。

expanded.G.s0048.visible_goal: When several units or events act at the same time, each feedback stays attached to the object it belongs to.
expanded.G.s0048.result_frame_description: A real multi-unit combat frame in which simultaneous damage figures and status effects sit on their own distinct units, so each can be attributed to the right actor or target.
expanded.G.s0048.correct_target_and_information: Each effect or number must be positioned on, and readable against, the unit that caused or received it; simultaneous events must not merge into one unattributable cluster.
expanded.G.s0048.necessary_context: A frame capturing the simultaneous moment; an adjacent frame only if two effects are transient and overlap.
expanded.G.s0048.representative_basic_function: Ending the turn with several enemies acting and their effects resolving together.
basic_function_bugs: Simultaneous feedback is all shown on one unit regardless of its source.
Effects overlap into an illegible cluster with no attribution.
One unit's feedback is dropped entirely while another's is duplicated.
expanded.G.s0048.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 并发单位或多个事件同时发生时，关键反馈仍能对应到正确对象。
